description: This file defines the Thread class and related thread-local storage template for managing threads within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and thread management mechanisms, but no method implementations.

classes.name: ThreadLocalStorageType
classes.description: Template class managing thread-local storage for a specified type, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Abstract class representing a thread, providing thread control, priority, and context management functionalities.

methods.name: ThreadLocalStorageType
methods.description: Constructor initializing thread-local storage key or index depending on platform.

methods.name: ~ThreadLocalStorageType
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up thread-local storage key or index.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of thread-local storage manager.

methods.name: Context
methods.description: Retrieves or creates thread-local storage instance for the current thread.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if thread-local storage is set for the current thread.

methods.name: Thread
methods.description: Constructor for creating a thread object with optional stack size and name.

methods.name: ~Thread
methods.description: Destructor for thread object.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends the thread execution.

methods.name: Block
methods.description: Blocks the thread.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the thread.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the thread.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts thread execution.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the thread.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the thread to reach a specified state or timeout.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the thread is running.

methods.name: IsBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the thread is blocked.

methods.name: IsFailed
methods.description: Checks if the thread has failed.

methods.name: PriorityMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum thread priority.

methods.name: PriorityMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum thread priority.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Returns the current thread ID.

methods.name: GetContext
methods.description: Template method to access thread-local storage of a specific type.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to the thread.

methods.name: GetCallstack
methods.description: Retrieves the call stack for debugging (debug build only).

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Virtual method to initialize thread resources.

methods.name: Worker
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented with thread's main function.

methods.name: Terminate
methods.description: Terminates the thread.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets or gets the thread's state.

methods.name: ThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread's name.

methods.name: StartThread
methods.description: Platform-specific static method to start thread execution.
